commentary_segments.text: When several fullydifferential amplifiers are used in series, for high-order filters for example, there is no need to have CMFB around each stage separately. In order to save power, CMFB can be applied over two differential amplifiers in series, as shown in this slide. Now, the average output voltage is measured at the output of the second amplifier, and applied to the common-mode input of the first amplifier. Since the common-mode output of the first amplifier is used to set the biasing of the second one, all common-mode levels are well defined.
